spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact proposal surface — Iterator.prototype.join via a generator instance, including the no-argument default-comma path — and parses null/undefined tokens so the proposal's Array-parity stringification is exercisable.

interactive.rationale: Two inputs and a run button drive the real call; the result panel shows the engine's actual string or actual TypeError.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a real-call playground with genuine errors; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Empty separator box exercises the default-argument path; null/undefined/number tokens cover the coercion cases; the unsupported path shows the real thrown error.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5095183554314240 plus the TC39 proposal and MDN iterator helpers.

conformance.rationale: The new suite asserts the prototype method, default separator, nullish stringification, empty-input, laziness, and ToString parity — the same contracts this playground exposes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: real call produced the genuine 'TypeError: gen(...).join is not a function' with the flag note visible; also tried --js-flags=--harmony-iterator-join and --harmony (still absent in this V8 — recorded, not hidden); zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for the native-ran and honest-unsupported branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; error result in accent-rose on paper (AA); ≥44px inputs.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled text inputs; the result panel is role=status aria-live; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column stack; long results word-break; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Verify the native success path on a V8 that stages iterator-join
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141's V8 lacks the method even behind --js-flags=--harmony-iterator-join / --harmony (verified). Re-run on Chrome 153 with chrome://flags/#enable-javascript-harmony and confirm the playground returns real joined strings for all token kinds.

guidanceConsulted.query: text inputs drive computed result accessible labels
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Programmatic labels and a clear run affordance for computed results.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both fields use <label for>; run is a native button; result is aria-live.

guidanceConsulted.query: single column playground long output wrapping
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: word-break long computed strings inside bordered panels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Result value uses word-break:break-all; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the real call path produces the genuine TypeError on Chromium 141 (also probed behind two V8 flag spellings — still absent, honestly recorded), console clean at both viewports. Native-success verification needs Chrome 153 and is the open question.
